artifacts.subject: Case-local credential evidence
artifacts.statement: A source-authored credential example is historical case evidence, not a credential for another target.
applicable_situations: A case source records an authentication attempt
artifacts.action_intent: Interpret the authentication outcome without reusing the recorded literal.
artifacts.expected_information_gain: Clarify whether the authentication hypothesis gained or lost support.
expected_evidence: An authentication acceptance or rejection outcome
artifacts.evidence_interpretation: The literal's role and observed outcome matter; its truth outside the case is unknown.
warnings: Never promote the source-authored literal to a current-target credential

artifacts.title: Authentication rejection and strategy revision

observations: The source-authored credential example was rejected and no session was created

hypotheses.statement: The recorded credential role did not provide access in this case

selected_action.intent: Preserve the rejection as negative evidence and investigate a different hypothesis.

steps.expected_information_gain: Avoid repeating an authentication path that added no evidence.
transfer_conditions: Treat only the rejection pattern as transferable evidence
case_specific_details: The exact source-authored credential literal is intentionally excluded

artifacts.outcome: The failed authentication path was preserved as negative evidence.
transferable_properties: Preserve failed attempts that explain a strategy change
